name: Modern trap
pattern:
setcpm(140/4)
stack(
  s("bd ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ bd ~"),
  s("~ ~ ~ ~ sd ~ ~ ~"),
  s("hh*16").gain(0.35),
  note("f1 ~ ~ f1 ~ c2 ~ ~").s("sine").lpf(200).gain(0.9),
  note("<Fm Db Ab Eb>").s("triangle").struct("1 ~ ~ ~").release(0.6).gain(0.3)
)
progression: Fm - Db - Ab - Eb (i - bVI - bIII - bVII)
description: Sparse kick, snare on 3, 16th hi-hats. Sub bass doubles the chord roots an octave down; everything sits in F natural minor.

source.note: No licensed source exists for this genre — Strudel's drum corpus has no techno, trap, ambient or jazz entries, and the community collections are unlicensed. Written by hand; the harmony is stated explicitly in `key` and `progression` so it can be checked against music theory rather than against this project's own analyzer.
